entries.en: entries needs at least one item

entry_id.zh: entries[{i}] 缺 entry_id（原生请求标识）
entry_id.en: entries[{i}] needs entry_id (the native request id)

harness.zh: entries[{i}] 的受控绑定没有登记宿主
harness.en: entries[{i}] has no host registered on its controlled binding

at.zh: entries[{i}].at 必须是数字（原生时刻）
at.en: entries[{i}].at must be a number (native time)

tokens.zh: entries[{i}] 的 {key} 必须是非负整数或省略
tokens.en: entries[{i}].{key} must be a non-negative integer or omitted

tokens_unknown.zh: entries[{i}].tokens 有不认识的分项 {key}，只收 in / out / cache
tokens_unknown.en: entries[{i}].tokens has unknown fields {key}; only in / out / cache are accepted
